verdict.rationale: Insomnia docs explicitly describe using the Insomnia CLI (inso) to automate API test execution in Git/CI workflows with unlimited collection runs, and a probe confirms the CLI is officially documented (inso-cli). This directly supports running collections in CI, though the docs don't explicitly detail exit-code/fail-build semantics or provide independent CI hands-on reports. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit codes/build-failure behavior on test regressions, and independent/community verification of CI usage.
